purpose: Reduce phone source-preparation and control-hunting friction by letting ordinary downloaded text-like files use the existing READFIELD work kernel, while clarifying cross-mode compositions.
behavior: The same FAST / REVIEW / PULSE / VOICE / LOCI / REPO controls operate on the local source.
The phone work rail stays sticky.
SKIM→REVIEW, LISTEN→PULSE→VOICE and READ→LOCI→RETURN are named as same-cursor work chains.
Ephemeral sources expose COPY FOCUS rather than a misleading durable addressed-view copy.
reference_sync: FIELD PULSE names READFIELD 0.8.5; authority remains NONE.

stop: After repository proof, stop reader feature growth until direct phone use identifies concrete friction in local-file intake, sticky rail, mode consequences or handoff.
